argv:
import collections,json,pathlib,subprocess,tomllib
r=pathlib.Path('.')
bm=json.load(open('/tmp/careops-e22-parent-before-dependencies-metadata-20261012.json'))
am=json.load(open('.artifacts/mvp/E2.2.fidelity.dependency-20261012-v2/logs/metadata-locked.json'))
def mi(p): return (p['name'],p['version'],p.get('source'))
bmc=collections.Counter(map(mi,bm['packages'])); amc=collections.Counter(map(mi,am['packages']))
reg='registry+https://github.com/rust-lang/crates.io-index'
expected_meta=collections.Counter({('kairo-ecs-des','0.1.0',None):1,('kairo-ecs-abm','0.1.0',None):1,('kairo-ecs-state','0.0.0',None):1,('thiserror','2.0.20',reg):1,('thiserror-impl','2.0.20',reg):1})
assert not (bmc-amc),f'baseline metadata identities removed/changed: {list((bmc-amc).items())}'
assert amc-bmc==expected_meta,f'unexpected metadata identity additions: {list((amc-bmc).items())}'
base_lock=tomllib.loads(subprocess.check_output(['git','show','f39fb9a173d06f426507a58fee5c3934e0dcd71b:Cargo.lock'],text=True))
final_lock=tomllib.loads((r/'Cargo.lock').read_text())
def li(p): return (p['name'],p['version'],p.get('source'),p.get('checksum'))
bc=collections.Counter(map(li,base_lock['package'])); ac=collections.Counter(map(li,final_lock['package']))
expected_lock=collections.Counter({('kairo-ecs-des','0.1.0',None,None):1,('kairo-ecs-abm','0.1.0',None,None):1,('kairo-ecs-state','0.0.0',None,None):1,('thiserror','2.0.20',reg,'ec86235f5fcc2a73650310756d2ac5b138a5780bbbdfae3eeccec992c435ba4f'):1,('thiserror-impl','2.0.20',reg,'bc04cd3e1236dd4a98afca4569f2deb3f120e5422a4023be2cb683f8486292af'):1})
assert not (bc-ac),f'baseline lock identities/checksums removed or changed: {list((bc-ac).items())}'
assert ac-bc==expected_lock,f'unexpected lock identity/checksum additions: {list((ac-bc).items())}'
rootm=tomllib.loads((r/'Cargo.toml').read_text()); edm=tomllib.loads((r/'crates/careops-ed/Cargo.toml').read_text())
for n in ('kairo-ecs-des','kairo-ecs-abm'): assert rootm['workspace']['dependencies'][n]['path']==f'libs/kairos/crates/{n}' and edm['dependencies'][n]['workspace'] is True
pkgs={p['id']:p for p in am['packages']}; edid=next(i for i,p in pkgs.items() if p['name']=='careops-ed' and p['version']=='0.1.0'); node=next(x for x in am['resolve']['nodes'] if x['id']==edid); edges={pkgs[d['pkg']]['name']:pkgs[d['pkg']] for d in node['deps']}
for n in ('kairo-ecs-des','kairo-ecs-abm'): assert n in edges and edges[n]['version']=='0.1.0' and edges[n].get('source') is None
assert collections.Counter(map(mi,am['packages']))==collections.Counter(map(mi,json.load(open('.artifacts/mvp/E2.2.fidelity.dependency-20261012-v2/logs/metadata-unlocked.json'))['packages']))
pin=subprocess.check_output(['git','-C','libs/kairos','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip(); assert pin=='832dfb159981f7bd5041e636a7c4d609b2bd6e9c',pin
print(json.dumps({'baseline_metadata_packages':sum(bmc.values()),'final_metadata_packages':sum(amc.values()),'baseline_lock_rows':sum(bc.values()),'final_lock_rows':sum(ac.values()),'new_package_names':['kairo-ecs-des','kairo-ecs-abm','kairo-ecs-state','thiserror','thiserror-impl'],'careops_ed_edges':{n:edges[n]['id'] for n in ('kairo-ecs-des','kairo-ecs-abm')},'kairos_pin':pin},sort_keys=True))
